source: NEW-TRACK-DETAILED.md (supplied 2026-10-07), an end-to-end operational procedure for house / tech-house. A procedure, not an authority: on any job another guide owns - HOOKS.md, LOW_END.md, GROOVE.md, CHORDS.md, MIXING.md, EMOTION.md, and Basslines in AGENTS.md - that guide wins. Its concrete numbers are labelled [AGENT-DEFAULT] or [AGENT-DERIVED] in the document: starting points, never measurements, so they do not override a value this project has measured.

action_fields.question: Which exact track, group, clip or return?
Which exact bar range or MIDI positions?
Which notes, samples, automation, device, routing or parameter?
Which number, bounded test set, or explicit rule?

checks: bass structural notes agree with the harmony
the top voice has a deliberate contour
percussion velocities are not all identical
bass groove locks with the kick
kick and bass roles are distinct
no uncontrolled overlap from impacts and reverbs
at each 8- or 16-bar boundary, name what changes
verify the change serves the energy direction
decide whether the processed version is genuinely better
the main chord identity survives mono
the main hook or vocal survives mono
at low level the hierarchy is groove, then main hook or vocal, then harmonic support, then detail
if detail dominates the hook, rebalance

failure_modes.problem: adding layers instead of fixing composition
failure_modes.fix: fix the notes, rhythm, contour and sound role of the weak part
a filter sweep cannot rescue a section containing the wrong elements
a kick needing 12 dB in several bands is the wrong kick
a well-voiced triad beats a badly voiced ninth
design in solo if needed, decide keep or delete in context

failure_modes.problem: treating visible spectrum peaks as problems
failure_modes.fix: cut only what causes an audible problem

translation_table.action: test a 7th on chord 1 or 2, then a 9th on one chord, and A/B against the triads
generate inversions, minimise semitone movement, preserve common tones
set a velocity cell; test swing at 52, 55 and 58 per cent; keep the kick straight
velocity hierarchy first; percussion timing within about 5 ms, only if needed
shorten notes and release; inspect the kick overlap; tune the ducking recovery
increase the contrast before the drop; restore the low end; remove masking; layers last
identify the owner; shorten tails; remove duplicate lows; duck; EQ last
pick one method - Saturator, Redux or filter drive - and level-matched A/B it
widen only a non-sub role; mono-test; reject it if phase is lost
automate a named parameter from value A to B over named bars
one structural accent plus one micro-variation per 8 bars as the starting budget
identify the exact resonance; reduce source and spacing first, then EQ
correct voicing, register, tails and arrangement before broad EQ cuts
velocity hierarchy plus controlled swing, never arbitrary randomisation

fx_budget_per_8_bars.note: A starting budget, not a quota. If constant events make the main groove hard to identify, remove FX.

eight_bar_change_rule.note: An inspection trigger, not a decoration trigger. Do not force a change every 8 bars if it harms the groove's hypnosis; but if no delta can be named across several boundaries, the arrangement is too static.
